GMRC Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 48 Draftsman, Engineer and More Posts - Complete Details

The Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation (GMRC) Recruitment 2026 for posts of 48 Manager, Draftsman, Engineer and More Posts. Candidates with B.Tech/B.E, Diploma Can Apply Online. The online application opens on 19-09-2026, and closes on 03-10-2026. The candidate shall apply online through GMRC website, gujaratmetrorail.com.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 19 September 2026
  • Last Date : 3 October 2026
  • Notification Date : 19 September 2026
  • Age and Experience Calculation Date : 19 September 2026

  • Additional General Manager : Rs.1,00,000–2,60,000
  • Joint General Manager : Rs.90,000–2,40,000
  • Senior Deputy General Manager : Rs.80,000–2,20,000
  • Deputy General Manager : Rs.70,000–2,00,000
  • Assistant Manager : Rs.50,000–1,60,000

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
